about.whatBody: Sittuyin is the traditional chess of Myanmar, a cousin of Thai chess and international chess. Only the Ne (pawns) start on the board: each player then places their own Min-gyi, Sit-ke, two Sin, two Myin and two Yahhta behind them, so no two games open the same way. A Ne promotes to a Sit-ke on the long diagonals, and when few pieces are left a count gives the stronger side a limited number of moves to deliver checkmate.
